new_results.content: Original global envelopes and finite annihilator central fraction hold uniformly for all (s,t) in [0,1]^2.
The central derivative form has norm at most Lambda=L_k epsilon_(k,J,D), using the logarithmic contrast rather than exp(L_k)-1.
Exact original restriction/attained quotient transport e^(-Lambda)<=metric ratio<=e^Lambda; actual minimum section error at starting metric <=(e^Lambda-1) times starting section norm.
Explicit annihilator inclusion, original remainder minimum and complementary Schur metric; no global determinant inferred from a local pair.
B=R-S with original weights 1,2,...,2,1; delta=outer leg minus central source-band change plus exact relation leg E, |E|<=2q Lambda_0.
|Delta_square B+Delta_square S|<=4q Lambda_0; uniform central-leg lower bound >=-2q K_h-2q Lambda_0.
Exact source-band mixed derivative is minus the original C x O integral of H(y)H(z) times the four-window signed sum of squared reproducing kernels.
